title: nrg-world-heavyweight
label: Ketsueki Ikeda

won.source: NRG's own show-recap post (31 July 2006) frames the main event as a rematch of "the first encounter between these two in 2000, when Ikeda first won the belt."

how: First won the title from Christopher Cannon in a 2000 encounter shown in the night's own video package; retained on the 31 July 2006 show by shoving Cannon off a ladder and then retrieving the title himself after a release Orange Crush variant left Cannon unable to continue.

title: nrg-world-tag-team
label: "Head Trauma" Inoue and "Executioner" Eddie Mills

won.source: Shown already holding the titles aloft in the show's own pre-taped video package (31 July 2006); no document in the held record dates when they won them.

how: Already the champions as shown in the night's own video package; not defended on this show.
